senses.d: A unit of time which is one sixtieth of an hour (sixty seconds).
ex: You have twenty minutes to complete the test.

ex: The Empress of Russia, with her own hand, minuted an edict for universal tolerance.

senses.d: Very small.
ex: They found only minute quantities of chemical residue on his clothing.

senses.d: Very careful and exact, giving small details.

senses.d: The ability to remember things.
ex: My mind just went blank.

senses.d: The ability to focus the thoughts.
ex: I can’t keep my mind on what I’m doing.

senses.d: Somebody that embodies certain mental qualities.

1684-1690, Thomas Burnet, The Sacred Theory of the Earth
